questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.answer: I am Anjali Krishna, a Junior Full Stack Developer with two years of experience. I have worked with JavaScript, React.js and basic backend technologies. I enjoy collaborating with teams and communicating technical ideas clearly.

questions.question: How do you handle disagreements with colleagues?
questions.answer: I listen to the other person's perspective and explain my opinion with reasons. I focus on finding a solution that supports the project rather than making the discussion personal.

questions.question: What motivates you at work?
questions.answer: Learning new technologies, solving problems and completing useful features motivate me. I also enjoy receiving feedback and improving my work.
